newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Arenas sees positive trends in Feb jobless.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Arenas sees positive trends in Feb jobless.

text.p: Spain's Labour Minister Javier Arenas said on Monday headline unemployment data for February appeared negative, but there were positive trends in the industry and construction sectors.
"One could interpret the unemployment data as negative... but we must point out a positive evolution in the industry and construction sectors," Arenas told reporters at a conference.
Spain's February unemployment rate rose to 14.11 percent from 14.07 percent in January. It stood at 15.44 percent in February 1996.
He also highlighted a certain pick-up in new contracts, but said many employers were delaying hiring until labour reform talks concluded.
